DmsSeparator

Gets or sets the character used to separate degrees, minutes, and seconds in DMS strings. Defaults to a narrow no-break space (U+202F).

Methods

CompassPoint(double, int)

Returns the compass point (to a given precision) for a supplied bearing.

public static string CompassPoint(double bearing, int precision = 3)

Parameters

bearing double

The bearing in degrees (0-360).

precision int

The precision of the compass point (1 for 8 points, 2 for 16 points, 3 for 32 points). Defaults to 3.

Returns

string

A string representing the compass point (e.g., "N", "NE", "NNE").

Examples

Console.WriteLine(Dms.CompassPoint(0));    // Output: N
Console.WriteLine(Dms.CompassPoint(22.5)); // Output: NNE
Console.WriteLine(Dms.CompassPoint(90));   // Output: E
Console.WriteLine(Dms.CompassPoint(315, 1)); // Output: N

Exceptions

ArgumentOutOfRangeException

Thrown if precision is not between 1 and 3.

Parse(string)

Parses a string representing degrees/minutes/seconds into numeric degrees.

public static double Parse(string dms)

Parameters

dms string

The DMS string to parse (e.g., "-3.62", "3 37 12W", "3°37′12″W").

Returns

double

The parsed value in decimal degrees, or NaN if parsing fails.

Examples

Console.WriteLine(Dms.Parse("53°08′45″N")); // Output: 53.145833333333336
Console.WriteLine(Dms.Parse("3 37 12W"));   // Output: -3.62
Console.WriteLine(Dms.Parse("-120.5"));     // Output: -120.5

Remarks

This method is very flexible on formats, allowing signed decimal degrees, or deg-min-sec optionally suffixed by compass direction (NSEW); a variety of separators are accepted.

Exceptions

ArgumentNullException

Thrown if the input string is null or empty.

ToBearing(double, string, int)

Converts numeric degrees to deg/min/sec as a bearing (0°..360°).

public static string ToBearing(double deg, string format = "d", int dp = 2)

Parameters

deg double

The decimal degrees bearing value.

format string

The format to use: "d", "dm", or "dms".

dp int

The number of decimal places.

Returns

string

A string representation of the bearing in DMS format.

Examples

Console.WriteLine(Dms.ToBearing(270.5, "dms", 0)); // Output: 270° 030´ 000"
Console.WriteLine(Dms.ToBearing(-45, "d"));       // Output: 337.5°

ToCoordinate(string, string)

Returns a Coordinate object by parsing strings of latitude and longitude in DMS format.

public static Coordinate ToCoordinate(string latDms, string lonDms)

Parameters

latDms string

The latitude string in DMS format (e.g., "53°08′45″N").

lonDms string

The longitude string in DMS format (e.g., "001°50′00″W").

Returns

Coordinate

A Coordinate object representing the parsed latitude and longitude.

Examples

var coord = Dms.ToCoordinate("53°08′45″N", "001°50′00″W");
Console.WriteLine($"Latitude: {coord.Latitude}, Longitude: {coord.Longitude}");
// Output: Latitude: 53.145833333333336, Longitude: -1.8333333333333333

Exceptions

ArgumentException

Thrown if either latitude or longitude cannot be parsed.

ToDms(double, string, int)

Converts decimal degrees to deg/min/sec format.

public static string ToDms(double deg, string format = "d", int dp = 2)

Parameters

deg double

The decimal degrees value.

format string

The format to use: "d" (degrees), "dm" (degrees and minutes), or "dms" (degrees, minutes, and seconds).

dp int

The number of decimal places for seconds (or minutes if format is "dm", or degrees if format is "d").

Returns

string

A string representation of the degrees in the specified DMS format.

Examples

Console.WriteLine(Dms.ToDms(53.145833, "dms", 0)); // Output: 053° 008´ 045"
Console.WriteLine(Dms.ToDms(53.145833, "dm", 2));  // Output: 053° 008.75′
Console.WriteLine(Dms.ToDms(53.145833, "d", 4));   // Output: 053.1458°

Remarks

Degree, prime, double-prime symbols are added, but sign is discarded, though no compass direction is added. Degrees are zero-padded to 3 digits.

ToLat(double, string, int)

Converts numeric degrees to deg/min/sec latitude format (2-digit degrees, suffixed with N/S).

public static string ToLat(double deg, string format = "d", int dp = 2)

Parameters

deg double

The decimal degrees latitude value.

format string

The format to use: "d", "dm", or "dms".

dp int

The number of decimal places.

Returns

string

A string representation of the latitude in DMS format with N/S suffix.

Examples

Console.WriteLine(Dms.ToLat(53.145833, "dms", 0));  // Output: 053° 008′ 045″ N
Console.WriteLine(Dms.ToLat(-25.1234, "dm", 2));   // Output: 025° 007.40′ S

ToLon(double, string, int)

Converts numeric degrees to deg/min/sec longitude format (3-digit degrees, suffixed with E/W).

public static string ToLon(double deg, string format = "d", int dp = 2)

Parameters

deg double

The decimal degrees longitude value.

format string

The format to use: "d", "dm", or "dms".

dp int

The number of decimal places.

Returns

string

A string representation of the longitude in DMS format with E/W suffix.

Examples

Console.WriteLine(Dms.ToLon(-1.833333, "dms", 0)); // Output: 001° 050′ 000″ W
Console.WriteLine(Dms.ToLon(150.7654, "dm", 2));  // Output: 150° 045.92′ E

Wrap180(double)

Constrains degrees to the range -180..+180 (for longitude) using a general sawtooth wave function.

public static double Wrap180(double degrees)

Parameters

degrees double

The degrees value to wrap.

Returns

double

The wrapped degrees value within the range -180 to 180.

Examples

Console.WriteLine(Dms.Wrap180(181));  // Output: 180.5
Console.WriteLine(Dms.Wrap180(-181)); // Output: -0.5
Console.WriteLine(Dms.Wrap180(360));  // Output: -90

Wrap360(double)

Constrains degrees to the range 0..360 (for bearings) using a general sawtooth wave function.

public static double Wrap360(double degrees)

Parameters

degrees double

The degrees value to wrap.

Returns

double

The wrapped degrees value within the range 0 to 360.

Examples

Console.WriteLine(Dms.Wrap360(361)); // Output: 180.5
Console.WriteLine(Dms.Wrap360(-1));  // Output: 359.5
Console.WriteLine(Dms.Wrap360(0));   // Output: 0
